html_source: Diagrams of a normal heart (left), in which high-oxygen blood (red) is pumped to the body and low-oxygen blood (blue) recovered from the body is pumped to the lungs, and an HLHS heart (right), in which the two kinds of blood mix in the single functioning ventricle. Source: Moss & Adams: Heart Disease in Infants, Children, and Adolescents (Philadelphia, 2022).

Diagrams of a normal heart (left), in which
  high-oxygen blood (red) is pumped to the body and low-oxygen
  blood (blue) recovered from the body is pumped to the lungs, and
  an HLHS heart (right), in which the two kinds of blood mix in
  the single functioning ventricle. Source: Moss & Adams:
  Heart Disease in Infants, Children, and Adolescents
  (Philadelphia, 2022).
